description: Design flows, visual systems, interaction states, accessibility, and prototypes.
exit_contract: approved experience contracts, evidence, and separate remediation or implementation handoffs

invalidate_on: source evidence becomes stale or fails verification

gates: select only atomic steps whose trigger matches and prerequisites are current
preserve candidate permission identity and mutation scope exactly
remote, local-system, external-session, and local-git steps remain disabled without fresh current authorization
hard dependencies are current-run prerequisites; optional dependencies never force activation; feedback dependencies feed a future pass and never block current-run execution
no passed handoff without complete four-part evidence contract

experience-design steps may be skipped as not applicable only when approved requirements explicitly state that the bounded change has no user-facing surface, user-visible state, content, accessibility, or interaction effect
human_checkpoint: human owns taste choices, prototype promotion, accepted findings, and design disposition

never_infer_from: absence of UI files in the proposed diff
skip_contract.required_evidence: approved requirements explicitly state no user-facing surface or effect

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Define and validate semantic, keyboard, focus, assistive-technology, visual-input, motion, and error-recovery behavior for specified user tasks.
hard_gates: A generic WCAG checklist cannot pass: every criterion must name a user task, state, expected observable behavior, and current evidence or explicit untested risk.
Review, evidence acquisition, preflight, and preservation audit never imply source remediation or release authority.
inputs: User tasks, supported browser and assistive technology, interaction states, WCAG scope, and an implementation.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Design bounded user interaction for AI latency, uncertainty, correction, personalization, escalation, and safe failure without hiding probabilistic behavior.
hard_gates: Never present generated content, confidence, personalization, or autonomous action as certain, authoritative, or irreversible when the system cannot prove it.
Review, evidence acquisition, preflight, and preservation audit never imply source remediation or release authority.
inputs: Probabilistic outputs, user context, interaction latency, correction signals, and accessibility needs.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Create truthful task-specific interface copy, realistic content data, and authorized assets with provenance and state coverage.
hard_gates: No placeholder, invented claim, unverifiable metric, fake social proof, or unlicensed asset may enter a candidate presented as realistic or release-ready.
Review, evidence acquisition, preflight, and preservation audit never imply source remediation or release authority.
inputs: Product facts, brand voice, content needs, licensed material, and asset-generation capability.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Run one bounded preflight across accessibility, authentic content, interaction states, responsiveness, motion, AI states, and release evidence without repairing source.
hard_gates: A preflight item passes only with current criterion-linked evidence; unchecked, not-applicable without rationale, and source-inspection-only items remain unresolved.
Review, evidence acquisition, preflight, and preservation audit never imply source remediation or release authority.
inputs: A rendered UI, acceptance criteria, content, supported devices, and release boundary.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Translate approved product behavior, audience, brand evidence, surface mode, content needs, and success criteria into an auditable design direction contract.
hard_gates: The design direction cannot pass unless each major visual or spatial choice traces to product purpose, audience, content, brand authority, or an explicitly human-owned taste decision.
Review, evidence acquisition, preflight, and preservation audit never imply source remediation or release authority.
inputs: Product facts, a brief, design assets, tokens, components, surface context, and references.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Choose or generate an in-project design-system foundation with semantic tokens, component contracts, states, themes, and persistence rules.
hard_gates: Do not create a parallel design system, token alias maze, or component abstraction when the existing project foundation can express the required states.
Review, evidence acquisition, preflight, and preservation audit never imply source remediation or release authority.
inputs: A UI brief, stack, design references, existing tokens, and project conventions.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Build genuinely divergent working UI variants in isolation, compare them on frozen criteria, and preserve human selection before promotion.
hard_gates: At least two variants must differ structurally on declared axes; palette-only or typography-only alternatives do not count as divergence.
Review, evidence acquisition, preflight, and preservation audit never imply source remediation or release authority.
inputs: One UI brief, project tokens, authentic context, and named axes of divergence.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Apply explicit UI release criteria to current rendered evidence, aggregate blocking findings, and recommend a bounded release disposition without source repair.
hard_gates: No release criterion may pass from source inspection, prior screenshots, or reviewer assertion when current rendered or interaction evidence is required.
Review, evidence acquisition, preflight, and preservation audit never imply source remediation or release authority.
inputs: An implementation, desktop and mobile captures, a brief, direction contract, target files, and findings.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Audit an existing interface and define a redesign preservation contract for product truth, user flow, information architecture, routes, SEO, analytics, behavior, and content.
hard_gates: No existing route, content obligation, analytics event, SEO contract, user task, or behavior may be silently removed because it appears visually obsolete.
Review, evidence acquisition, preflight, and preservation audit never imply source remediation or release authority.
inputs: An existing UI, brand, tokens, information architecture, content, routes, analytics, and redesign brief.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Extract observable design primitives from supplied authorized external captures or files, normalize them with provenance and confidence, and stop before project token writes.
hard_gates: Observed external values are evidence, not project authority: no project token, copied asset, or design decision may be written or approved by this capability.
Review, evidence acquisition, preflight, and preservation audit never imply source remediation or release authority.
inputs: An authorized public reference, extraction runtime, and requested analysis mode.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Define and implement coherent controls, navigation, forms, validation, loading, empty, error, permission, disabled, success, interruption, and recovery states.
hard_gates: The happy path cannot pass alone: every applicable loading, empty, validation, error, permission, disabled, interruption, success, and recovery state must exist and be reachable for verification.
Review, evidence acquisition, preflight, and preservation audit never imply source remediation or release authority.
inputs: User flows, acceptance criteria, a component system, content, state model, and platform behavior.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Implement deterministic, interruptible, reduced-motion-safe animation that communicates hierarchy, causality, navigation, feedback, or state.
hard_gates: Motion without a named communication purpose, deterministic end state, interruption behavior, and information-equivalent reduced-motion path must be removed or blocked.
Review, evidence acquisition, preflight, and preservation audit never imply source remediation or release authority.
inputs: Interaction states, motion intent, frequency, platform capability, and accessibility constraints.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Independently critique current rendered UI and animation behavior, prioritize reproducible findings, and recommend a bounded disposition without source mutation.
hard_gates: Static source review, DOM assertions, or a single ideal screenshot cannot substitute for current rendered evidence across the declared routes, states, viewports, input modes, and motion behavior.
Review, evidence acquisition, preflight, and preservation audit never imply source remediation or release authority.
inputs: Rendered captures, interaction traces, design criteria, accessibility context, and implementation constraints.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Design and implement semantic information hierarchy, layout, density, grid, reflow, and content rhythm across supported viewports and zoom levels.
hard_gates: Desktop and mobile endpoints are insufficient: the layout must survive intermediate widths, 200% zoom, long or localized content, overflow, and touch-target constraints without losing task order.
Review, evidence acquisition, preflight, and preservation audit never imply source remediation or release authority.
inputs: A visual direction, content structure, device classes, breakpoints, and existing layout constraints.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Define independent UI review scope and acquire authorized current rendered evidence without evaluating findings or repairing source.
hard_gates: No capture is review evidence unless its source revision, runtime, route, state, viewport, zoom or scale, input mode, timestamp, tool, and hash are recorded and current.
Review, evidence acquisition, preflight, and preservation audit never imply source remediation or release authority.
inputs: A UI brief, target files, runtime, rendered surfaces, and review criteria.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Classify UI work, authorization, current lifecycle state, target surfaces, evidence needs, and one next atomic capability without doing downstream design or review.
hard_gates: Routing must not smuggle design, review, source mutation, browser capture, or release judgment into the intake artifact.
Review, evidence acquisition, preflight, and preservation audit never imply source remediation or release authority.
inputs: A UI request, project state, existing interface, target files, authorization, and design artifacts.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Establish and implement a purposeful visual language that reinforces hierarchy and brand evidence while rejecting generic template patterns and unsupported decoration.
hard_gates: Every prominent visual device must serve hierarchy, task, content, state, or evidenced brand identity; unsupported decoration and generic template motifs must be removed.
Review, evidence acquisition, preflight, and preservation audit never imply source remediation or release authority.
inputs: A direction contract, brand, tokens, audience, surface mode, and content.
